title: Quentin and the Will
author: Oscar Eastwick
blurb: Odile Reyes, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
